description: Parameters: positionals, specials, arrays, namerefs and attributes.

cases.name: param: readonly assignment abandons its line
cases.script:
readonly r=1
r=2; echo same-line
echo next=$?
f() { r=3; echo in-f; }
f; echo after-f
echo last

cases.name: param: nameref as a for variable
cases.script: target=""; declare -n ref=target; for ref in a b c; do echo "loop: target=$target"; done; echo "final: target=$target"

cases.name: param: exported nameref reaches a child as its name
cases.script: target=value; declare -nx myref=target; bash -c 'echo "myref: $myref"'

cases.name: param: nameref to an element in arithmetic
cases.script: arr=(0 1 0); declare -n ref='arr[1]'; echo $(( ref ? 100 : 200 ))

cases.name: param: dollar zero and dash
cases.script: echo $- | grep -q h && echo hashall; case $- in *c*) echo command-string;; esac; set -u; case $- in *u*) echo nounset;; esac

cases.name: param: last argument
cases.script: echo a b c >/dev/null; echo $_; true last; echo $_

cases.name: param: status and pid
cases.script: false; echo $?; echo $? ; [ $$ -gt 0 ] && echo pid; sleep 0.01 & [ $! -gt 0 ] && echo bgpid; wait

cases.name: param: array quoting
cases.script: a=("x y" z); for e in "${a[@]}"; do echo "[$e]"; done; for e in ${a[@]}; do echo "<$e>"; done

cases.name: param: array element operations
cases.script: a=(apple banana cherry); echo ${a[1]:0:3} ${a[@]^} ${#a[2]}; unset a; echo ${#a[@]}

cases.name: param: negative index errors
cases.script: a=(1 2); echo ${a[-3]}; echo status=$?; a[-3]=x; echo status=$?

cases.name: param: associative arrays
cases.script: declare -A m; m[one]=1; m[two]=2; m["with space"]=3; echo ${m[one]} ${#m[@]} "${m[with space]}"; for k in "${!m[@]}"; do echo "$k=${m[$k]}"; done | sort

cases.name: param: associative literal and unset
cases.script: declare -A m=([a]=1 [b]=2 [c]=3); unset "m[b]"; echo ${#m[@]}; [[ -v m[a] ]] && echo has-a; [[ -v m[b] ]] || echo no-b; printf "%s\n" "${m[@]}" | sort

cases.name: param: associative arrays need declare
cases.script: m[k]=v; echo ${m[k]} ${m[0]}; declare -p m

cases.name: param: namerefs
cases.script: declare -n r=target; r=value; echo $target; target=changed; echo $r; f() { local -n out=$1; out=result; }; f dest; echo $dest

cases.name: param: namerefs to arrays
cases.script: arr=(1 2 3); declare -n ref=arr; echo ${ref[1]} ${#ref[@]}; ref+=(4); echo ${arr[@]}

cases.name: param: nameref loops
cases.script: a=1 b=2; for n in a b; do declare -n v=$n; echo $v; done; declare +n v; echo done

cases.name: param: integer attribute
cases.script: declare -i i=10; i+=5; echo $i; i="i*2"; echo $i; declare +i i; i=3+3; echo $i

cases.name: param: export reaches children only when exported
cases.script: x=plain; export y=exported; bash -c 'echo "[${x-}] [${y-}]"'; z=inline bash -c 'echo "[${z-}]"'

cases.name: param: allexport
cases.script: set -a; w=auto; set +a; bash -c 'echo "[${w-}]"'

cases.name: param: export -n and -p
cases.script: export e=1; export -n e; bash -c 'echo "[${e-}]"'; export -p | grep -c " e=" ; echo status=$?

cases.name: param: readonly and declare -r in functions
cases.script: f() { local -r c=1; c=2; echo status=$?; }; f 2>/dev/null; readonly -f f 2>/dev/null; echo done

cases.name: param: RANDOM and SECONDS
cases.script: [[ $RANDOM =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( RANDOM < 32768 )) && echo random; (( SECONDS >= 0 )) && echo seconds; [[ $EPOCHSECONDS =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && echo epoch

cases.name: param: BASH_SOURCE and LINENO in a script
cases.script:
echo "[${BASH_SOURCE[0]-}]"; echo $LINENO
echo $LINENO

cases.name: param: unset variables in nounset
cases.script: set -u; echo "${x-default}"; echo "${arr[@]-}"; ( echo $undefined ) 2>/dev/null; echo status=$?

cases.name: param: special parameters in functions
cases.script: f() { echo "$0|$#|$*"; }; f a b; set -- x; f; echo $#

cases.name: param: assignment before a command
cases.script: x=outer; x=inner true; echo $x; f() { echo $x; }; x=temp f; echo $x

cases.name: param: variable names
cases.script: a_1=1 _b=2; echo $a_1 $_b; 1x=3 2>/dev/null; echo status=$?

cases.name: param: a nameref to an array element reads and assigns it
cases.script: a=(1 2 3); declare -n r='a[1]'; echo "read=[$r]"; r=x; echo "${a[*]}"; r+=z; echo "${a[*]}"; (( r = 7 )); echo "${a[*]}"; (( r += 5 )); echo "${a[*]}"; declare -A m=([k]=v); declare -n mr='m[k]'; echo "[$mr]"; mr=w; echo "${m[k]}"; i=2; declare -n ri='a[$i]'; ri=last; echo "${a[*]}"

cases.name: param: a nameref to an element in a function and an arithmetic for loop
cases.script: f() { local -n e=$1; e=changed; }; b=(1 2 3); f 'b[1]'; echo "${b[*]}"; arr=(0); declare -n ref='arr[0]'; for (( ref=1; ref<=3; ref++ )); do echo "ref=$ref arr0=${arr[0]}"; done

cases.name: param: read into an array element
